create_gaussiandiffusion: create a GaussianDiffusion instance with a beta schedule, model mean type, variance type, and loss type
get_named_beta_schedule: get a predefined linear or cosine beta schedule for a given number of diffusion timesteps
p_sample_loop: generate samples from a diffusion model by iteratively denoising from random noise over all timesteps
ddim_sample_loop: generate samples from a diffusion model using the faster deterministic DDIM sampling method
training_losses: compute training losses for a diffusion model at a single timestep given inputs and noise
